name: Kami Mirror Tempest
summary: The Kami campaign travels through storm shrines, mirror lakes, and foxfire gates where every reflection can become a hostile tactical lane. Full mission-arc recreation pass now rewrites all seven Mythos Gates routes with route-native chapter arcs, mission titles, objectives, dialogue hooks, and mission art prompts.
loreDirectorNotes: Focuses on contracts with spirits rather than conquest. The campaign tests whether the Creator can win without breaking local shrine law.
gameplayDirectorNotes: Map layouts favor shifting lanes, reflection decoys, wind pushes, cleanse objectives, and high-mobility enemy spirits. Current pass targets dungeon-route pacing, one-deity readability, shrine/treasure/boss nodes, and faction-specific hazard language.
artDirectorNotes: Vermilion torii gates, moonlit water, lacquer black shrine roofs, paper seals, foxfire blue, and mirror-surface battle grids.
developmentDirectorNotes: Ideal for testing terrain state changes and illusion markers after base tactical loop stabilizes.
recommendedNextTask: Tune individual boss mechanics and playable route UI now that every route has rewritten mission arcs.

mobileUe5Architecture.structure: Campaign → Region → Zone → Exploration → Encounter → Tactical Combat → Reward → Next Zone
mobileUe5Architecture.zoneStrategy: large detailed modular zones, not seamless open world and not generic corridors
mobileUe5Architecture.prototypeGate: Do not expand implementation ahead of approved first-zone loop.

oneTitanVsManyCombat.fictionLabel: one selected playable deity against many enemies

mythosGatesCampaignRecreation.combatRule: one selected god or goddess enters each dungeon/combat route; no armies, no squads, no simultaneous party
mythosGatesCampaignRecreation.loreRule: Ascension expands existing divine power during the Gate crisis; it never turns mortals into gods and never reduces Gates to simple portals.
